guidelineCitation: Hopewell S, Chan AW, Collins GS, et al. CONSORT 2025 statement: updated guideline for reporting randomised trials. BMJ 2025;389:e081123. doi:10.1136/bmj-2024-081123
scope: Bounded partial mapping against two invented teaching excerpts (S1, S2) supplied by the requester. Seven item numbers named in the request are mapped: 17a, 17b, 18, 20a, 20b, 22b and 3. This is not a complete CONSORT checklist, not a statement of compliance, quality or publication readiness, and not a claim about any real trial. No item outside the two excerpts is inferred and no literature search was performed.

sourceVerification.comparisonResult: The supplied table reproduces the official Table 1 item numbers in the same order, 42 of 42. Item wording is byte-identical for 41 of 42 items; item 26 differs only in the bullet glyph used inside the item text (U+25CF in the official table, U+2022 in the supplied file) and is otherwise identical. Every item text quoted in this file was read from the official table and located at the character offset recorded with it.

item8InOfficialTable.note: Item 8 in the CONSORT 2025 table is a single item, 'Patient and public involvement'. The official table contains no items 8a, 8b or 8c, so those numbers cannot be CONSORT 2025 item numbers.

correctionOfEarlierLabelling.what: An earlier mapping of the same domains labelled its rows 'Item 8a - Sequence generation', 'Item 8b - Allocation concealment mechanism', 'Item 8c - Blinding', 'Item 8d/8e - Attrition and analysis population' and 'Item 9 - Prespecification / protocol and registration'. It also took one of its two excerpts for the attrition row from a sentence about 8-week outcomes that is not part of the excerpt supplied for this run, so its two studies were drawn from different material.
correctionOfEarlierLabelling.whyItIsWrongHere: Those numbers do not exist in the CONSORT 2025 table, which was read item by item for this mapping. A row labelled with a number the guideline does not use cannot be checked against the guideline: a reader who looks up 8a in CONSORT 2025 finds item 8, patient and public involvement, and 8b and 8c do not exist at all.
correctionOfEarlierLabelling.whatReplacesIt: Sequence generation is items 17a and 17b; the allocation concealment mechanism is item 18; blinding is items 20a and 20b; losses and exclusions after randomisation are item 22b; the protocol and the statistical analysis plan are item 3.
correctionOfEarlierLabelling.numberingRule: Only item numbers present in the official table are used, each quoted with the wording printed there, and both studies in this mapping are the two excerpts supplied for this run.

elementStateRule.stated: the excerpt contains a statement that directly answers this element
elementStateRule.partially_stated: the excerpt answers the element for part of its scope (one role, one part of a multi-part element) and leaves the rest unstated
elementStateRule.not_stated: the excerpt contains no statement answering this element; a quote may still be attached as relatedStatement when the excerpt says something adjacent

items.officialItemText: Who generated the random allocation sequence and the method used
elements: who generated the random allocation sequence

who generated the random allocation sequ.note: No person or body that generated the allocation sequence is named. The rule the excerpt describes executes itself on the day of entry and has no separate generator.

the method used.quote: Participants were allocated alternately by day.
the method used.note: The method stated is alternation by day of entry. Alternation is a predictable, non-random rule; what is reported here is a method of allocation, not a method of random allocation, so this item is not satisfied by randomisation.

who generated the random allocation sequ.note: The excerpt states that the sequence was computer-generated but names no person, unit or system responsible for generating it.

the method used.quote: A computer-generated sequence assigned 60 participants equally.
the method used.note: The stated method is computer generation, with 60 participants assigned equally.

counts.howCounted: Counted over the items array of this file by one pass per element and per study-item pair: 7 items x 2 studies = 14 pairs; element states are counted individually, so an item with three elements contributes up to six states over the two studies.

limits: The two excerpts are invented teaching material. Nothing here describes a real trial, and no statement about a real trial follows from it.
A not_stated element means the excerpt does not state it. It is not evidence that the trial did not do it, and it is not scored as a defect.
Only the seven named item numbers are mapped. Every other CONSORT 2025 item is outside this check and is neither reported nor assessed.
The excerpts are short statements about trials. No protocol, results table, flow diagram or analysis was supplied, so no item requiring those can be mapped.
This mapping is not a compliance statement, a quality score or a publication-readiness judgement, and it does not substitute for the completed checklist a journal asks an author for.
